functions.name: AssignStringToPropertyDirect
functions.signature: AssignStringToPropertyDirect(In String, In Prop, In Data)
functions.docs:
Util to assign a value (given as a string) to a struct property.
This always assigns the string to the given property without adjusting the address.

functions.name: AssignStringToProperty
functions.signature: AssignStringToProperty(In String, In Prop, In Data)
functions.docs:
Util to assign a value (given as a string) to a struct property.
When the property is a static sized array, this will split the string and assign the split parts to each element in the array.

functions.name: GetPropertyValueAsStringDirect
functions.signature: GetPropertyValueAsStringDirect(In Prop, In Data, In DT Export Flags)
functions.docs:
Util to get a property as a string.
This always gets a string for the given property without adjusting the address.

functions.name: GetPropertyValueAsString
functions.signature: GetPropertyValueAsString(In Prop, In Data, In DT Export Flags)
functions.docs:
Util to get a property as a string.
When the property is a static sized array, this will return a string containing each element in the array.

functions.name: GetPropertyValueAsTextDirect
functions.docs:
Util to get a property as text (this will use the display name of the value where available - use GetPropertyValueAsString if you need an internal identifier).
This always gets a string for the given property without adjusting the address.

functions.name: GetPropertyValueAsText
functions.docs:
Util to get a property as text (this will use the display name of the value where available - use GetPropertyValueAsString if you need an internal identifier).
When the property is a static sized array, this will return a string containing each element in the array.

functions.name: GetStructPropertyNames
functions.docs: Util to get all property names from a struct.

functions.name: MakeValidName
functions.docs: Util that removes invalid chars and then make an FName.

functions.name: IsSupportedTableProperty
functions.docs: Util to see if this property is supported in a row struct.

functions.name: GetPropertyExportName
functions.docs: Util to get the friendly display unlocalized name of a given property for export to files.

functions.name: GetPropertyImportNames
functions.docs: Util to get the all variants for export names for backwards compatibility.

functions.name: GetPropertyDisplayName
functions.docs: Util to get the localized display name of a given property.

functions.name: GetColumnDataAsString
functions.signature: GetColumnDataAsString(In Table, Property Name, In DT Export Flags)
functions.docs: Output each row for a specific column/property in the table (doesn't include the title)

functions.name: AddRowJSON
functions.signature: AddRowJSON(In Data Table, In JSON Data, Out Problems, Remove Duplicate, Out Row Name)
functions.docs: Add a row from a json format to a datatable
